issue.title: Mavsdk and Ros2 causes nondescript segfault
issue.body:
Minimal example of node that tries to use Mavsdk. This example works if mavsdk is commented out or ros2 is not used. If Mavsdk is initialized at all in a Ros2 node, it causes a segfault.

```bash
~/workspace/px4_mission_service$ find *
CMakeLists.txt
src
src/node.cpp
~/workspace/px4_mission_service$ cat src/node.cpp 
#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>
#include <mavsdk/mavsdk.h>

struct Px4MissionService : public rclcpp::Node {
	mavsdk::Mavsdk sdk;

	Px4MissionService() 
		: rclcpp::Node("px4_mission_service"),
		  sdk(mavsdk::Mavsdk::Configuration{mavsdk::ComponentType::GroundStation}) 
	{}
};

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	rclcpp::init(argc, argv);
	rclcpp::spin(std::make_shared<Px4MissionService>());
	rclcpp::shutdown();
	return 0;
}
```

comments.body: What MAVSDK version is that? Built or installed how?

Release 3.16.0, installed via the .deb
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v3.16.0/libmavsdk-dev_3.16.0_ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb

```bash
~/workspace/px4_mission_service/build$ apt search mavsdk
Sorting... Done
Full Text Search... Done
libmavsdk-dev/now 3.16.0 amd64 [installed,local]
  no description given
```

Ok, looks like the problem is symbols clashing because the default is public.

This is fixed in main by https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/2824 but we might have to do some backported version of it for v3.
Gotcha, I'll test this out tomorrow morning and see if I can validate.
Just released [v3.17.0](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/tag/v3.17.0). Give it a try!

Ok, I tried with both v3.17.0 and commit ec516ce982d9e30b58fbb74355a90f6d93ec606d on main, and both still segfault. I also noticed that main installs "/usr/local/include/mavsdk/mavsdk.**hpp**" while v3.17.0 installs "/usr/include/mavsdk/mavsdk.**h**". main also is still labelled "/usr/local/lib/libmavsdk.so.**3.15.0**".

I might need to check this on a clean machine, I'm wondering if it's an environment problem on my end.

**Investigation summary for #2852**

The root cause is **symbol leakage** from `libmavsdk.so`. MAVSDK statically links OpenSSL, tinyxml2, and curl into its shared library, but those symbols remain globally visible. When loaded alongside ROS2 (which uses FastRTPS -> OpenSSL/tinyxml2), the dynamic linker resolves FastRTPS's calls to MAVSDK's bundled copies, causing ABI mismatches and the segfault.

Confirmed via `LD_DEBUG=bindings`:
```
binding file /opt/ros/jazzy/lib/libfastrtps.so.2.14 [0] to /lib/libmavsdk.so.3 [0]: normal symbol `OPENSSL_init_crypto'
binding file /opt/ros/jazzy/lib/libfastrtps.so.2.14 [0] to /lib/libmavsdk.so.3 [0]: normal symbol `_ZN8tinyxml211XMLDocumentC1E...'
```

**What we tried:**
1. Backported PR #2824 (`-fvisibility=hidden` + `MAVSDK_PUBLIC` annotations) to v3 -> branch `v3-symbol-visibility`
2. Built a .deb from that branch and tested in Docker with the reproducer from this issue

**Result:** Still crashes. `-fvisibility=hidden` only affects symbols compiled with that flag. The statically-linked third-party `.a` files (OpenSSL, tinyxml2, curl) were built without it, so their symbols are still exported from `libmavsdk.so`.

**Next step:** Add a **linker version script** to the shared library build. This tells the linker to hide all symbols except the MAVSDK public API, regardless of how the static libraries were compiled:

```
# libmavsdk.version
{
  global:
    _ZN6mavsdk*;   # mavsdk:: namespace
    _ZNK6mavsdk*;  # const methods in mavsdk::
    extern "C++" {
      "mavsdk::*";
    };
  local:
    *;
};
```

Applied in CMake with:
```cmake
set_target_properties(mavsdk PROPERTIES
    LINK_FLAGS "-Wl,--version-script=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libmavsdk.version"
)
```

issue.body:
Backport of #2824 to v3. Fixes segfault when MAVSDK is used alongside ROS2 (or any library sharing bundled dependencies like OpenSSL/tinyxml2) due to symbol conflicts from leaked third-party symbols.

- Add mavsdk_export.h with MAVSDK_PUBLIC, MAVSDK_TEST_EXPORT, and MAVSDK_TEMPL_INST macros
- Set CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET=hidden and VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN=ON
- MAVSDK_SHARED compile definition gates dllexport/dllimport so that static builds on Windows are unaffected
- Annotate all public classes, free functions, operator overloads, and explicit template instantiations
- Update jinja2 templates to emit MAVSDK_PUBLIC on generated operator== and operator<< definitions
- Disable MSVC C4251 warning for DLL interface on STL members

Fixes #2852

**Investigation summary for #2852**

The root cause is **symbol leakage** from `libmavsdk.so`. MAVSDK statically links OpenSSL, tinyxml2, and curl into its shared library, but those symbols remain globally visible. When loaded alongside ROS2 (which uses FastRTPS -> OpenSSL/tinyxml2), the dynamic linker resolves FastRTPS's calls to MAVSDK's bundled copies, causing ABI mismatches and the segfault.

Confirmed via `LD_DEBUG=bindings`:
```
binding file /opt/ros/jazzy/lib/libfastrtps.so.2.14 [0] to /lib/libmavsdk.so.3 [0]: normal symbol `OPENSSL_init_crypto'
binding file /opt/ros/jazzy/lib/libfastrtps.so.2.14 [0] to /lib/libmavsdk.so.3 [0]: normal symbol `_ZN8tinyxml211XMLDocumentC1E...'
```

**What we tried:**
1. Backported PR #2824 (`-fvisibility=hidden` + `MAVSDK_PUBLIC` annotations) to v3 -> branch `v3-symbol-visibility`
2. Built a .deb from that branch and tested in Docker with the reproducer from this issue

**Result:** Still crashes. `-fvisibility=hidden` only affects symbols compiled with that flag. The statically-linked third-party `.a` files (OpenSSL, tinyxml2, curl) were built without it, so their symbols are still exported from `libmavsdk.so`.

**Next step:** Add a **linker version script** to the shared library build. This tells the linker to hide all symbols except the MAVSDK public API, regardless of how the static libraries were compiled:

```
# libmavsdk.version
{
  global:
    _ZN6mavsdk*;   # mavsdk:: namespace
    _ZNK6mavsdk*;  # const methods in mavsdk::
    extern "C++" {
      "mavsdk::*";
    };
  local:
    *;
};
```

Applied in CMake with:
```cmake
set_target_properties(mavsdk PROPERTIES
    LINK_FLAGS "-Wl,--version-script=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libmavsdk.version"
)
```

This needs to go into both v3 and main. The Docker reproducer is in `issue_2852/` in the repo.

**Reproducer:** `issue_2852/Dockerfile` (based on `ros:jazzy`, installs MAVSDK .deb, builds minimal ROS2+MAVSDK node)

Here is the dockerfile:

```
FROM ros:jazzy

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    gdb \
    wget \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install MAVSDK 3.17.0 .deb
RUN wget -q https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v3.17.0/libmavsdk-dev_3.17.0_ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb \
    && dpkg -i libmavsdk-dev_3.17.0_ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb \
    && rm libmavsdk-dev_3.17.0_ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb

# Create the reproducer project
RUN mkdir -p /workspace/px4_mission_service/src
COPY node.cpp /workspace/px4_mission_service/src/node.cpp
COPY CMakeLists.txt /workspace/px4_mission_service/CMakeLists.txt

# Build the reproducer
WORKDIR /workspace/px4_mission_service
RUN bash -c "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && \
    mkdir build && cd build && \
    cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug .. && \
    make -j$(nproc)"

CMD ["./build/mission_service"]
```

issue.title: fix: hide third-party symbols from libmavsdk.so to prevent clashes

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Related to #2852 but on main.

libmavsdk.so statically links OpenSSL, tinyxml2, and curl but their symbols remained globally visible. When loaded alongside libraries that use the same dependencies (e.g. ROS2 FastRTPS), the dynamic linker would resolve calls to MAVSDK's bundled copies, causing ABI mismatches and segfaults.

Add linker symbol export lists (GNU ld version script for Linux, ld64 exported_symbols_list for macOS) that restrict exports to the mavsdk:: namespace plus a few test-support symbols. This drops exported symbols from ~20,000 to ~2,900.

Closes #2852

The visibility annotations from #2855 only affect code compiled with -fvisibility=hidden. Statically-linked third-party libraries (OpenSSL, tinyxml2, curl) were built without it, so their symbols still leak from libmavsdk.so and clash with other libraries (e.g. ROS2 FastRTPS).

Add linker symbol export lists (GNU ld version script for Linux, ld64 exported_symbols_list for macOS) that restrict exports to the mavsdk:: namespace plus mavlink_get_channel_status (needed by tests).
